verdict.rationale: llama.cpp's official repo documents a first-party `llama` CLI, with `llama cli -hf <model>` for interactive and VLM sessions and `llama serve` for the server and web UI. It ships via release binaries and Winget. Hands-on community reports confirm the official CLI tooling works, e.g. llama-mtmd-cli chatting with images and running the release binaries on macOS. Missing for 10: in-depth CLI reference documentation (flags, non-interactive/scriptable usage) and evidence of agent-oriented workflows built on the CLI.
